options.content: **Bird Eyes** · price dashboard: web, Redis, SRH, refresh CronJob · [birdeyes.npty.online](https://birdeyes.npty.online) · [Overview](/d/k12-overview)

panels.title: Status
panels.description: Latest Gatus check for Bird Eyes (K12). Full history: https://gatus.npty.online

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Share of Gatus checks that passed in the selected time range.

panels.title: Pods ready
panels.description: Ready pods in namespace bird-eyes. 0 means nothing is running.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Container restarts in the selected time range.

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: LogsQL: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="bird-eyes"} | filter level:error OR (-level:* "Error") | stats count(). Over the selected time range.

panels.title: Warnings
panels.description: LogsQL: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="bird-eyes"} | filter level:warn OR (-level:* "warn") | stats count(). Over the selected time range.

panels.title: Crypto quotes
panels.description: Crypto quotes fetched and saved in the selected range. Closed markets are not fetched.

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="bird-eyes"} event:quote market:=crypto outcome:ok | stats count() n

panels.title: US quotes
panels.description: US quotes fetched and saved in the selected range. Closed markets are not fetched.

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="bird-eyes"} event:quote market:=us outcome:ok | stats count() n

panels.title: Thai (SET) quotes
panels.description: Thai (SET) quotes fetched and saved in the selected range. Closed markets are not fetched.

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="bird-eyes"} event:quote market:=set outcome:ok | stats count() n

panels.title: London quotes
panels.description: London quotes fetched and saved in the selected range. Closed markets are not fetched.

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="bird-eyes"} event:quote market:=lse outcome:ok | stats count() n

panels.title: Market status now (last 6 minutes)
panels.description: The refresh runs every 5 minutes and reports every market, open or closed. Stale = older than the market's trading hours explain.

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="bird-eyes"} event:market.refresh _time:6m | stats by (market, phase) max(tracked) tracked, max(stale) stale, max(missing) missing, min(newest_age_s) newest, max(oldest_age_s) oldest | sort by (market)

defaults.noValue: No refresh in the last 6 minutes

panels.title: Stale or unpriced assets
panels.description: Assets per market with an old quote or none at all.

panels.title: Quotes per hour by market
panels.description: Saved quotes per hour.

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="bird-eyes"} event:quote outcome:ok | stats by (market) count() quotes

panels.title: Failed quotes per hour by market
panels.description: Assets a refresh tried and no provider priced.

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="bird-eyes"} event:quote outcome:failed | stats by (market) count() failed

panels.title: Latest quote per asset
panels.description: The newest saved quote of every asset in the selected range.

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="bird-eyes"} event:quote outcome:ok | last 1 by (_time) partition by (market, symbol) | sort by (market, symbol) | fields _time, _msg, market, symbol, price, change_pct, currency, provider, age_s

panels.title: Failing assets
panels.description: Assets that could not be priced, worst first. Empty is good.

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="bird-eyes"} event:quote outcome:failed | stats by (market, symbol) count() failed | sort by (failed desc) | limit 20

panels.title: Refresh runs
panels.description: Price refresh runs (one every 5 minutes).

panels.title: Failed runs
panels.description: Runs where many assets failed or the store was unreachable.

panels.title: Slow refresh (p95)
panels.description: 95% of runs finish faster than this.

panels.title: Late quotes accepted
panels.description: Quotes older than 10 minutes, saved because no provider had a newer one.

panels.title: Providers
panels.description: One call is one batch sent to a provider. No API key = this server has no credential for it, so the next provider in line is used.

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="bird-eyes"} event:provider.request | stats by (provider) count() calls, count() if (outcome:failed) failed, count() if (outcome:not_configured) no_key, sum(requested) asked, sum(returned) got, quantile(0.5, duration_ms) p50, quantile(0.95, duration_ms) p95 | sort by (calls desc)

panels.title: API requests
panels.description: Includes the status monitor's health checks.

panels.title: Charts loaded
panels.description: Chart history requests.

panels.title: Watchlist changes
panels.description: Assets added or removed, and lists reordered.

panels.title: Failed sign-ins
panels.description: Wrong password entered.

panels.title: API routes
panels.description: Server routes: request count and latency.

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="bird-eyes"} event:api.request | stats by (route) count() calls, count() if (outcome:failed) failed, quantile(0.5, duration_ms) p50, quantile(0.95, duration_ms) p95 | sort by (calls desc) | limit 20

panels.title: Chart history by market
panels.description: Where chart data came from.

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="bird-eyes"} event:history.request | stats by (market) count() requests, count() if (outcome:cached) cached, count() if (outcome:fetched) fetched, count() if (outcome:stale) stale, count() if (outcome:failed) failed, quantile(0.95, duration_ms) p95 | sort by (requests desc)

panels.title: Other events
panels.description: Everything else the app reports.

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="bird-eyes"} event:in(premarket.refresh, maintenance.task, watchlist.change, watchlist.search, auth.login, price.manual, instrument.resolve, watchlist.restore, server.started) | stats by (event) count() times, count() if (outcome:failed) failed | sort by (times desc)

panels.title: Log lines and errors per hour
panels.description: Hourly log volume (blue) and error lines (red).

panels.title: CPU and memory
panels.description: CPU (cores, left) and working-set memory (right) of namespace bird-eyes.

panels.title: Needs attention: errors and warnings
panels.description: Error lines (A) and warning lines (B), newest first. Empty is good.

targets.expr: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="bird-eyes"} | filter level:error OR (-level:* "Error") | format "error" as level
{kubernetes.pod_namespace="bird-eyes"} | filter level:warn OR (-level:* "warn") | format "warn" as level

panels.title: Latest log lines
panels.description: LogsQL: {kubernetes.pod_namespace="bird-eyes"}. Every line from this app, newest first.

options.content: One namespace holds the web app (Bun server for the SPA and API), Redis (AOF on a PVC), serverless-redis-http (SRH) in front of Redis, and the `refresh-prices` CronJob (every 5 minutes), which logs the HTTP status and the start of the response. Gatus checks `/health`. Log, CPU and memory panels cover the whole namespace. The app logs one JSON line per event (`event`, `level`, `market`...); the market, provider and usage panels read those fields. Events cover this K12 server only, not the Vercel one.
